lines.6: 「I act tough, but the truth is, I'd like to try dating a flesh-and-blood girl too.」
lines.7: 「What are you talking about? You're creepy.」
lines.8: 「Wouldn't want to interrupt. We're heading home.」
lines.9: 「Use the front door when you leave... Honestly.」
lines.10: 「--So that happened just now. I couldn't stand how jealous it made me.」
lines.11: 「It really felt like the unwanted guests should clear out.」
lines.12: 「So that means you get to lounge around in my room?!」
lines.15: 「You get to hang out in the room of a girl this cute. Take a moment to appreciate your good fortune.」
